gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-source-sans-3: Expressive, stencil-cut lines give Balsamiq Sans a constant weight and not a single pinched curve. Source Sans 3 is the modern foil, a sans whose a opens its lower bowl to breathe.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-spinnaker: Bold, with no pinch in any curve of Balsamiq Sans. Spinnaker, a plain sans with apertures that keep every counter open to the outside, takes over the reading while the heading's line never shifts weight.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-stick: Expressive heading letters in Balsamiq Sans hold a stencil-cut constant weight, while Stick draws tubelike lines of its own. The shared steady line is the draw, with Stick's exits letting light through.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-suse: Balsamiq Sans draws bold, stencil-cut letters that keep one constant weight through every curve. SUSE sets rope-thick curves and open bowls, so a sans paragraph should read friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-suse-mono: Loud, expressive marker lines: Balsamiq Sans draws each glyph with the simplicity of one tip. SUSE Mono, a plain sans with generous space on both sides of each letter, should read approachable over many lines.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tajawal: Balsamiq Sans gives horizontals the same heft as verticals, a bold, expressive heading with no pinched turns. Tajawal, a plain sans built on a broad hook of a c, should read cleanly and quietly for pages.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tasa-explorer: Curves as thick as the straight stems define Balsamiq Sans. TASA Explorer, a plain sans whose curves end like lifted brush strokes, sits beside it feeling lighter and friendlier.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tasa-orbiter: Expressive neon-tube strokes run through Balsamiq Sans, every curve holding its width, while TASA Orbiter keeps small counters unclogged. Small body sizes should hold up fine in that sans, counters staying open.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-telex: Thick, loose and loud, Balsamiq Sans holds its width through every turn while Telex relaxes into curvy letters. Paragraphs in that plain sans should feel unclamped, unhurried and easy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans reads at a smoothed pace, its light stroke variation keeping c tips from creeping together. And Balsamiq Sans, bold and expressive, holds one constant weight, a soft hum beside it.
